title: Refill Thresholds and Early Refill Override Allowances — Pharmacy Benefit Chart
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, all PrairieRx plans.** The chart shows how much of the prior fill's days supply must have elapsed before a refill pays, and how many early refill overrides each plan allows per drug.

| PrairieRx plan | Refill threshold (share of prior days supply elapsed) | Threshold for controlled substances CII–CV | Vacation overrides per drug, rolling 365 days | Most extra days one vacation override releases | Lost or stolen overrides per drug, rolling 365 days | Police report number needed for a controlled substance lost or stolen override |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrairieRx Dual Wrap | 75% | 90% | 0 | 0 | 1 | Yes |
| PrairieRx Expansion Adult | 75% | 90% | 1 | 34 | 1 | Yes |
| PrairieRx Adult | 75% | 90% | 1 | 34 | 1 | Yes |
| PrairieRx Children | 75% | 90% | 1 | 34 | 1 | Yes |
| PrairieRx Maternity | 75% | 90% | 1 | 34 | 1 | Yes |
| PrairieRx Complex Care | 75% | 90% | 2 | 34 | 2 | Yes |
| PrairieRx Long-Term Care | 75% | 90% | 0 | 0 | 1 | Yes |

### Reading the chart

- The two thresholds are the same on every plan: 75 percent of the prior fill's days supply for an ordinary drug and 90 percent for a controlled substance in schedules CII to CV.
- PrairieRx Dual Wrap and PrairieRx Long-Term Care allow no vacation override (0 overrides, 0 extra days).
- PrairieRx Complex Care is the only plan allowing 2 vacation overrides and 2 lost or stolen overrides per drug in a rolling 365 days; every other plan allows 1 lost or stolen override.

### Worked reading (hypothetical)

A prior fill of 30 days supply for a drug that is not controlled reaches the 75 percent threshold once 22.5 days of it have elapsed; the same 30-day fill of a CII–CV drug reaches the 90 percent threshold once 27 days have elapsed.
